title: Ringing in Ears Tinnitus Treatment
summary: A short promotional video demonstrating a head-thumping technique that is claimed to relieve tinnitus. Covering the ears and tapping the back of the head is said to silence the ringing temporarily.
why: Tinnitus sufferers share it as a free trick that briefly stops the ringing, though not as a cure.

quote.text: this trick helped me be in silence for the first time in decades.
